description: This is a C# source file defining an abstract class 'AzureEmailProviderBase' that implements email sending functionality using Azure Communication Services. It manages email content, attachments, recipients, and error handling, and provides a base for specific Azure email provider implementations.

classes.name: AzureEmailProviderBase
classes.description: An abstract class providing base functionality for Azure-based email providers, including sending emails, handling attachments, and managing recipients.

methods.name: SendAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends an email message, handling validation, error checking, and utilizing Azure Communication Email client.

methods.name: FromMailMessage
methods.description: Converts a MailMessage object into an Azure EmailMessage, processing recipients, content, reply-to addresses, and attachments.

methods.name: ConvertMailAddressToAzureEmailAddress
methods.description: Converts a System.Net.Mail.MailAddress to an Azure Communication EmailAddress.
